notes.title: Demo Update
notes.content:
[h1]Newly Added Abilities[/h1]
[list]
[*] Torpedo Cannonballs
[i]Launch gunpowder powered cannonballs towards enemy ships and attack them from below[/i]

[*] Air Strike
[i]Fire a barrage of cannons into the sky to wreck multiple enemies[/i]

[*] Mace
[i]A rotating mace attached to your ship to wreck other ships[/i]
[/list]
[h1]Newly Added Power Ups[/h1]
[list]
[*] Piercing Cannonballs
[i]Cannonballs that can pierce through enemies without losing momentum, allowing you to strike multiple ships at once[/i]

[*] Ramming
[i]Sink enemy ships by ramming your armored ship through them[/i]
[/list]

[h2]Smaller Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] Pink Gem now pulls in everything, not only XP and loot

Cheers,
Aremji Games

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.content:
Ahoy Pirates!

A bunch of small updates have been implemented into the Ocean Survivors Demo!


[list]
[*] Enemy cannonballs are now color coded red for better visibility
[*] Sky Pirate hit detection has been reworked to be more efficient in sinking ships
[*] Various VFX have been added to increase visibility
[*] Trireme (charging enemy) has more health - Balancing
[/list]

Cheers,
Aremji Games
